title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web agents are increasingly deployed to complete tasks autonomously on real websites, where adversarially injected content can induce them to perform unauthorized actions. Existing evaluations primarily use fixed attacks or focus on a single attack type, and evaluate attacks at the text level rather than through real state changes, thus underestimating how vulnerable agents are to diverse attacks. To address the gap, we introduce REEF, a benchmark of red-teaming executable environments with faithful verification for measuring the security vulnerabilities of web agents. REEF covers 9 verifier-grounded websites spanning travel, commerce, productivity, media, and communication, and pairs every authentic benign task with a malicious objective delivered through 5 attack types at both the user and the environment level. REEF's state-based verifiers provide the execution feedback that drives ANGLER, an adaptive near-miss-guided lure evolution

translated_title: ANGLER：面向网络代理的基于验证器的基准测试与自适应攻击者
translated_abstract: 网络代理正日益被部署在真实网站上自主完成任务，而对抗性注入的内容可能诱导其执行未经授权的操作。现有评估主要采用固定攻击或仅关注单一攻击类型，并且在文本层面而非真实状态变化层面评估攻击效果，从而低估了代理面对多样化攻击时的脆弱性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了REEF，一个具备可信验证的红队可执行环境基准，用于衡量网络代理的安全漏洞。REEF涵盖9个由验证器支撑的网站，遍及旅行、商务、生产力、媒体和通信等领域，并将每个真实的良性任务与通过用户和环境两个层面、共5种攻击类型传递的恶意目标配对。REEF基于状态的验证器提供执行反馈，驱动ANGLER——一种自适应的、由“险些成功”（near-miss）引导的诱饵演化方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了带有可信状态验证器的红队测试基准REEF与自适应攻击演化方法ANGLER，通过真实状态变化而非文本层面来评估网络代理在多样化攻击下的安全脆弱性。
